description: Variation of condition 4 (opening hours) in relation to unit 4 to allow for additional hours of opening to Monday to Sunday and public holidays 7:00 to 23:00 of planning permission 00607/D3-4/P2 approved 05/02/2018 for the variation of condition 3 (opening hours), to allow for additional hours of opening, of planning permission 00607/D3-4/P1 approved 09/11/2017 for the conversion into two separate units with part change of use from hair and beauty salon (A1) to Cafe (A3)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission reference 00607/D3-4/P1.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 10th December 2017 and numbered Location plan, and proposed floor plans (unnumbered)  and application from received on 20th November 2019 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The opening hours of the unit in use as a Hair and Beauty Salon (Class A1) shall be as follows: Monday to Sunday, and Public Holidays: 08:00 am to 21:00 pm.
Condition : 4 - The opening hours of the unit to be used as a cafe (Class A3) shall be as follows: Monday to Sunday, and Public Holidays: 07:00 am to 23:00 pm.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
